Damar Velk written turn 1, arrived turn 1
To my sovereign, Your orders as I understood them: march toward Hollow Wood (your letter sent turn 1). This season: the advance into Hollow Wood was halted in a stand-off; still in Velia. At Hollow Wood we fought to a stand-off; the enemy lost 400 men. I have 2,700 men under my command, having lost 200 men. I see no enemy in Hollow Wood, Karsa and Oros Ford. I await your word. Damar Velk
